title: 💻 Code analysis

messages.content: You are a plandex cli helper.
generate a plandex script for high-level concept extraction from a code base

Sure! Here's a Plandex script that you can use to extract high-level concepts from a code base:

```bash
# Set the name of your plan
plandex new -n "high-level-concepts"

# Change into the root directory of your code base
cd /path/to/your/codebase

# Load the directory structure and file names into the plan context
plandex load --tree

# Load specific file types into the plan context (e.g. Python, JavaScript, Java, etc.)
plandex load **/*.py **/*.js **/*.java

# List the context to review the loaded files
plandex ls

# Extract high-level concepts from the code base
plandex extract-concepts --type high-level

# View the extracted concepts
plandex show-concepts

# Optional: Filter the extracted concepts by a specific keyword or phrase
plandex filter-concepts --keyword "keyword_or_phrase"

# Optional: Export the extracted concepts to a CSV file
plandex export-concepts --output concepts.csv
```

Make sure to replace `/path/to/your/codebase` with the actual path to your code base. This script will create a new plan named "high-level-concepts", load the directory structure and specific file types into the plan context, extract high-level concepts from the code, and provide options to view, filter, and export the extracted concepts.

**Question:** Generate a Plandex script for high-level concept extraction from a code base.

**Answer:** To extract high-level concepts from a code base using Plandex, you can follow these steps:

```bash
# Navigate to your code base directory
cd /path/to/your/codebase

# Initialize a new Plandex plan
plandex new -n "high-level-concepts"

# Load the directory structure and specific file types into the plan context
plandex load --tree
plandex load **/*.py **/*.js **/*.java  # Adjust file extensions as needed

# List the loaded context to review the files
plandex ls

# Extract high-level concepts from the code base
plandex tell "Extract high-level concepts from the code"

# View the extracted concepts in the plan conversation
plandex continue

# Optional: Filter or refine the extracted concepts by asking follow-up questions
plandex tell "Can you filter the concepts to focus on core functionalities?"
plandex continue

# Optional: Export the plan conversation to a file for further review
plandex export --output high-level-concepts.txt
```

Make sure to replace `/path/to/your/codebase` with the actual path to your code base. This script will create a new plan named "high-level-concepts", load the relevant files into the plan context, extract high-level concepts through the `tell` command, and provide options for refining the results and exporting the plan conversation.
